card.name: Dosing table column headers
card.fires_on: Separators and symbols inside flattened table headers for dosing tables, such as a slash, an opening parenthesis, or a space between a drug name or unit and the next column. It fires after text like 'Table 1' and column titles.

modes.label: Slash between units
modes.description: A slash in a column header between drug names or units such as mg/24 hr or mGy/MBq.
modes.example: Creatinine Clearance mL/min Vancomycin Dose mg<</>>24 hr 100

modes.label: Other header breaks
modes.description: A parenthesis, number, or space at the edge of a column title just before the dose values.
modes.example: Table 1. Pediatric Dosage by Weight Weight Group (kg) Daily Dosage<< (>>mg/kg/day) Maximum Daily Dosage

card.plain: It marks the header row of a dosing table, where column titles run together before the numbers start.
